theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_pfi_gram_jacobian_algebra
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P), (∀ L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P, Real.sqrt (((L ∘L A).adjoint ∘L (L ∘L A)).det) ≤ ‖L‖ ^ n * Real.sqrt ((A.adjoint ∘L A).det)) ∧ (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |α (fun j => A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))| ≤ Real.sqrt ((A.adjoint ∘L A).det) * ‖α‖) ∧ (Injective A → ∀ ξ : MultiVector P n, IsUnitOrientationOf ξ (LinearMap.range (A : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) → ∃ s : ℝ, (s = 1 ∨ s = -1) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, Real.sqrt ((A.adjoint ∘L A).det) * ξ α = s * α (fun j => A (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))))
